emotional_tone: Authority, precision, functional beauty, and objective progress. The learning experience should feel like operating high-end industrial tech.

typography.font_install_instructions: Import Cabinet Grotesk from fontshare or standard cdn. Import IBM Plex Mono from Google Fonts.

hierarchy.h1: font-['Cabinet_Grotesk'] text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-black text-[#0A0A0A]
hierarchy.h2: font-['Cabinet_Grotesk'] text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-none font-extrabold text-[#0A0A0A]
hierarchy.h3: font-['Cabinet_Grotesk'] text-xl sm:text-2xl tracking-tight font-bold text-[#0A0A0A]
hierarchy.overline: font-['IBM_Plex_Mono'] text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-gray-500

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Asymmetry, Sharp Grid Borders (Neo-Brutalism).
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px or 2px solid black borders on major structural elements to create a technical 'Control Room' aesthetic.

components.buttons: rounded-none border-2 border-black bg-white text-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-colors duration-200 font-['IBM_Plex_Mono'] uppercase tracking-widest text-sm py-3 px-6
components.cards: rounded-none border-2 border-black bg-white p-6 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-200
components.inputs: rounded-none border-2 border-black bg-white focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-[#0055FF] font-['IBM_Plex_Mono']
components.badges: rounded-none border border-black px-2 py-1 text-xs uppercase font-['IBM_Plex_Mono'] tracking-widest bg-[#FFD700] text-black

pages.landing: Massive typography. Use 'hero_image' abstract pattern as a sharp, boxed hero asset. Incorporate an editorial marquee reading 'PYTHON / DATA SCIENCE / AI ENGINEERING'.
pages.dashboard: Strict grid lines (Control Room grid mode). High contrast metrics. Emphasize current streak and progress bar.
pages.curriculum: Timeline or Asymmetrical grid. Locked topics have dashed borders and grayed text. Unlocked have solid black borders. Completed have solid black background with white text.
pages.lesson_view: Editorial reading layout. Large text for clarity. Embedded code blocks must use a high-contrast dark theme (e.g., pure black background with neon syntax highlights) against the white page.
pages.playground: Two-pane or resizable split view. Editor on the left, output terminal on the right. Must look like a real IDE terminal.
pages.exam: Focus mode. Huge timer in IBM Plex Mono. Minimalist distraction-free layout.
pages.certificate: Pure CSS/HTML. Stark editorial design. Huge 'CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION' in Cabinet Grotesk. 4px black borders, technical 'document' vibe with subtle geometric alignments.

media_assets.description: Abstract minimalist background, Swiss style, strict grid patterns, light grey and signal blue intersecting lines. Use in hero section as an inset image or graphic asset.
Focused businesswoman coding. Use in about section or motivation banner.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use pure CSS and Tailwind for the layout. Ensure Shadcn components are modified to have 'rounded-none' to match the brutalist tech vibe.
Install Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react (as requested by user, but Phosphor preferred for dev tools. If restricted to Lucide, use sharp variants).
Implement Pyodide properly for the interactive code playground.
Use localStorage for saving ALL state: progress, unlocked modules, exam scores, code snippets.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
Use CSS Grid prominently. Draw 1px borders around grid items to create the 'exposed skeleton' look.
Do NOT use gradients. Use solid colors: White, Black, Signal Blue, Warning Yellow.
